title: CLI startup: probe Python frameworks in one process
goal: Every susi command primes the agent catalogs, and the Framework catalog probed each Python framework with its own python3 -c 'import X' (16 probes, ~0.87 s of a ~1.8 s launch). The gmcp_requirements tests launch susi hundreds of times, which made the root-cli shard and the coverage ratchet the 25-45 min poles of main's post-merge suite. Probe every Python import of a catalog in one interpreter per program, same import semantics, falling back to single probes if the batch fails.
